title: Credit Department Rate Table: Service Charges, Past-Due Triggers and Reinstatement across the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
Every programme of Crop Input Purchasing Accounts carries its own monthly service rate, its own days of grace, its own floor under a charge, its own triggers for the past-due flag and for suspension, its own reinstatement share and its own smallest acceptable part payment. The table is the authority for those figures.

| Programme | Monthly service rate (percent) | Grace (calendar days) | Floor under a charge (USD) | Past-due trigger (days) | Suspension trigger (days) | Suspension balance (USD) | Reinstatement share (percent) | Smallest part payment (percent of balance) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cash Purchase Account | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 100 |
| Standard 30-Day Charge Account | 1.5 | 10 | 5 | 1 | 60 | 25000 | 100 | 25 |
| Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account | 1.25 | 15 | 10 | 1 | 45 | 75000 | 75 | 25 |
| Early Pay Prepay Program Account | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 100 |
| Full Acre Input Financing Account | 0.95 | 15 | 25 | 1 | 30 | 150000 | 50 | 20 |
| Precision Partner Input Program Account | 0.85 | 20 | 25 | 1 | 30 | 250000 | 50 | 20 |

## Notes

1. The monthly service rate is the rate carried on an overdue balance, stated per month. A programme showing 0 carries no monthly rate, and a programme that carries no monthly rate assesses no service charge however long an invoice runs; those programmes accordingly show no grace, no floor and no triggers.

2. The grace days are the calendar days allowed after the due date before a service charge is assessed, and the floor is the least any assessed charge may be.

3. The past-due trigger is the calendar days beyond the due date at which the account is flagged past due; on every programme of Crop Input Purchasing Accounts that carries terms it is 1 day.

4. The suspension trigger is the days past the due date at which buying is suspended, and the suspension balance is the overdue balance at or above which suspension is applied regardless of days.

5. The reinstatement share is the share of the overdue balance that must be paid for buying to be reinstated; the smallest part payment is the least share of the balance that will be accepted as a part payment, and a programme showing 100 percent accepts nothing less than the whole.

## Boundary reading (hypothetical)

An invoice on the Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account that stands unpaid on the 15th day after its due date is still inside that programme's 15 days of grace; the same invoice on the 16th day is beyond it. On the Precision Partner Input Program Account, whose grace is 20 days, the 16th day is still inside.
